response.what_it_is: A black and white Furgle gaming chair and a black adjustable standing desk/table setup.
visible_condition: Light creases on the chair seat cushioning
Clean overall appearance with no major tears or visible damage
hidden_risks: Functionality of the motorized or crank adjustable table mechanism
Condition and stability of the chair's gas lift hydraulic cylinder
Wear on internal foam padding of the chair
Integrity of caster wheels and armrest adjustments
response.best_proof: A video clip demonstrating the smooth height adjustment of the table and the reclining/hydraulic functions of the chair.
seller_claims_unsupported: Excellent condition (mechanical functionality cannot be verified from static photos)
response.failure_mode: Failing to account for the combined value of both the motorized desk and the branded gaming chair, or misjudging the mechanical wear of adjustable components.
